NextSpace provides innovative physical and virtual infrastructure that freelancers, entrepreneurs, and creative class professionals need to succeed in the 21st century knowledge economy. In an increasingly disconnected world, NextSpace creates a collaborative community that is revolutionizing the nature of work.

We became a B Corp due to our obsessive enthusiasm for and focus on community, serving our members, and encouraging local economic development. We see revolutionizing the nature of work as the basis for revolutionizing the way we live, play, and thrive as a society.

NextSpace sells membership into that collaborative community, solving two fundamental problems for its members: isolation and need for a professional workspace and infrastructure. The real magic happens when our members collaborate in big and small ways. They share expertise. They refer business to each other. They combine talents to tackle larger projects. They even found companies together. We call it The NextSpace Effect and it’s the single biggest value that NextSpace provides. We provide the social and economic support structure that our society has created around traditional employment for those freelancers and independent workers.

Our mission is to ignite the (r)evolution of Work by creating a unique combination of workspace + community. Our vision is to bring the (r)evolution of Work to every market in the world. To do this, Paradigm comes alongside well-established global relief and development organizations such as World Vision, the World Food Program, Food 4 The Hungry and others to help them identify, fund and develop scalable projects that meet immediate development needs while creating a foundation for long-term community benefit through the realization of project-related carbon revenues.
 
 One example of this strategy is the alliance World Vision and The Paradigm Project have formed to develop large-scale efficient stove programs all around the globe. Because of their environmental benefits, efficient cookstoves can also generate carbon offsets which can be sold to create a stream of revenue that covers ongoing project costs and funds other community benefit projects.

By shaking up the way veterans and employers meet, the Rose Group has done away with hiring conferences, job fairs, and large contingency fees and replaced them with sensible products, services that work and a more personal approach.

Every candidate gets an intake session that assesses their military experience, career interests and job hunting skills. The Rose Group leaves the military member we talk to with better resumes, better interview skills, and teaches them job hunting skills.  

We became a B Corp because it was our way of signaling that we are a different type of staffing firm: getting people jobs they love and helping employers find awesome team members drives us, not profits, not fees, not closing the deal. Our concern for our community is expressed in the way we do business. 15 years ago, our founder got her first job out of college by a person who valued her military service, this is just our way of paying it forward.The Change We Seek

Good Eggs is an online market that delivers good groceries to customers' homes throughout the Bay Area, seven days a week. We’re making it easy for busy people to eat well at home by curating a marketplace full of the best local, organic produce, sustainable meat and fish, and delicious grocery staples. Order your groceries today on our site or app, and they’ll be on your doorstep tomorrow. It’s that simple.

Good Eggs was founded in San Francisco in 2011 with a mission to grow and sustain local food systems worldwide. The company now works with hundreds of local and sustainable food producers  and delivers delicious, fresh food seven days a week across the San Francisco Bay Area.

With its innovative model, the company operates a foodhub where orders are prepped and packed, but products aren’t stored for more than a few hours. Customers place their orders in advance and producers deliver exactly what’s been purchased. Food is made fresh, delivered to Good Eggs, and then delivered to the customer all in the same day... just in time for dinner.

Woven into the fabric of Good Eggs is the idea that we’re all responsible for helping to create a better world—and that a better world can be delicious! By becoming a B Corp, we’re dedicating ourselves to upholding the principles that first ignited our hearts and minds: people matter, nature is priceless and everyday choices make a difference.

The Change We Seek	

Good Eggs believes that food is at the heart of our most important relationships: to each other, to ourselves, and to nature. As people start to demand more from their food and get more of it from local food systems, Good Eggs believes we’ll see real change: healthier people, stronger communities, thriving environments—not to mention tastier food!

With a set of strong criteria for the food it carries and the producers it works with, Good Eggs offers customers something beyond the convenience of grocery delivery. Good Eggs enables customers to connect with their local farmers, butchers and bakers; to eat seasonally and mindfully; and to cast a vote for the kind of world they want to live in. In order to grow local food systems, Good Eggs supplements its local selection of goods with some carefully-chosen products from a wider radius. An audit of all products sold between December 16, 2013 and December 16, 2014 found that on average 91% of goods sold came from producers within 200 miles of their respective food hubs.

Working at Good Eggs means healthy compensation and benefits, opportunities for advancement, purpose, and a sense of community. In 1927, Cyril Anthony Lagomarsino founded a real estate/insurance business called CAL Insurance and CAL Realty. The name of the businesses, contrary to most people’s belief, has nothing to do with the state of California or the University of California, but Cyril’s initials.

CAL Insurance & Associates now has over 25 employees and prides itself on the services it provides its customers. It provides all lines of insurance including business, employee benefits, home, automobile, umbrella, and earthquake coverage. CAL is big enough to have a wealth of markets, yet small enough to identify themselves as a regional insurance agency.

CAL’s motto “Always Looking Out for You” is a core philosophy. In addition to providing insurance for its customers, CAL President, Scott Hauge has become a leader in the small business community in San Francisco, Sacramento, and Washington DC. He has saved millions of dollars for small business in taxes and established programs that have helped them to comply with regulations and obtain government contracts. He has also co-founded a free health clinic that serves the working uninsured through the generosity of retired doctors and volunteers. The clinic does not accept government money and solely operations on the community’s participation and private donors. 



Like our motto, we look out for not only our clients but also our employees and community. We became a B Corp to help set the standard in what it means to do business – helping out your neighbor and keeping them in mind when you make your decisions. It is also a great honor to be part of the B Corp family with like-minded businesses. 

The Change We Seek	

Insurance has a real problem with its image in the community. CAL Insurance strives to be recognized as a good corporate citizen. That is why CAL created Small Business California (smallbusinesscalifornia.org) which provides information to California small businesses and advocates for small businesses in Sacramento. In fact, Small Business California was one of the major supporters of the legislation that created B Corps. 

CAL Insurance is also an active participant with Volunteers in Medicine. This organization currently has 96 clinics in 29 states. It is a network of free clinics that serves the working uninsured .The program takes no government money and solely operates on the generosity of Foundations, Corporations, Small Business individuals and its Volunteers. One of the VIM clinics is Clinic by the Bay in San Francisco, which CAL co-founded. 

Looking out for the community also includes the environment and employees. CAL strives to be a model employer by providing competitive salaries and generous bonuses based on profits of agency, time off, benefits and continued education. Through action they also instill sustainability into their employees by changing the way they dispose of waste, use energy-efficient practices, and buying supplies locally. Being a B Corporation will add to CAL’s ability to further make positive changes for our employees, customers and the entire community!

“As a long time super satisfied customer of Cal Insurance we know that not only do we get great pricing and unmatched service but our insurance dollars go that extra mile in supporting your community service work. We look for that in all of our vendor relationships and are proud to be with you in the B-Corp community.” – Michael Hannigan, President of Give Something Back

Law++ has an award winning history of strong pro bono services, benevolent networking, and creating everlasting relationships with the goal of building a stronger community.



The firm offers fractional general counsel services, formations, contract drafting and reviewing, mergers and acquisitions, estate planning documents and more, all of which is focused around protecting the business and the business owner's legacy.



We decided to become a Certified B Corporation because the certification provides an outside seal of approval and accountability for what we've already been doing. It also showcases to our clients the mission we've been trying to promote. The assessment and the community have helped us craft a better business for ourselves and the community.

The Change We Seek	



Law Plus Plus's aims to change the way the legal system operates through easy to understand policies and procedures, transparency, and a better connection to the community. Part of this goal is to inspire others to be more involved in community service and pro bono work.



Law Plus Plus focuses heavily on ensuring that every person who wants to start a business has the legal resources to be able to do it, regardless of income. They also spend much of their time advocating and volunteering to protect those who could use allies in the political sphere.

Social Atlas facilitates partnerships across corporate, government and the for purpose sectors to create, implement and deliver social impact projects. They believe in business for good and deliver innovative, impactful programs for their clients and their communities.




By engaging with organisations in each sector Social Atlas provide a broad range of services depending on clients needs but always with an view to creating positive social impact through collaboration. Helping for purpose organisations better understand how they operate, identify opportunities for income generation, improved efficiency and effectiveness of impact or helping a corporate client better articulate how it can embed a shared value approach into its strategy and execute against it, Social Atlas takes a systems approach to everything it does. Looking for lasting impactful responses to those wicked social problems.



We became a B Corp because we believe in business for purpose. B Corp certification allows us to communicate that we are committed to this ideal internally as well as being advocates for the ideal externally.



In a changing world with a blurring of the for profit and not for profit spectrum, Social Atlas understands the potential for unlocking the resources in the market for the benefit of society. Becoming part of the B Corp community and working with like minded organisations on this journey felt like a natural next step and it also made great business sense.

The Change We Seek	



Social Atlas believes that successful, intentional partnerships formed around a shared vision of positive social impact, can change the world. They seek a change in the conversation across sectors to unlock this potential.

Clean Ethics creates uniquely formulated all natural, biodegradable cleaners for drinking containers and beverage systems. Their products are changing the way people sanitize these hard to clean drinking vessels by providing a solution that is safe, effective and convenient. Clean Ethics' aim is to offer products with minimal impact to the environment and maximum benefit to the consumer. They are committed to:Creating safe and effective drinkware cleaning products that contain exclusively natural ingredients.Using packaging that maximizes recycled, recyclable, and biodegradable materials.Reducing bottled water waste by offering a convenient cleaning method for reusable drinking containers.Helping solve fundamental water sanitation issues in developing countries.Producing products that are made in the USA.

Since we started our business we have always had a gut feeling of the right things to do and a strong desire to implement those “right things”. That was not enough for us - we were searching for metrics; a way to quantify our sustainable business practices. The B Corp model gave us those metrics. The process reassured us that we were on the right track and helped us find more ways to be a valuable part of the growing ethical business community.

The Change We Seek	

Clean Ethics seeks to change the way people clean portable drinking containers by:Helping people avoid toxic chemicals by creating safe and effective drinkware cleaning products that contain exclusively natural ingredients. Their products are certified by the Natural Products Association, ensuring that their ingredients are petrochemical free and sustainable.Reducing landfill waste by using packaging that maximizes recycled, recyclable, and biodegradable materials. Clean Ethics' pouches are made from plants and are municipally compostable. Their boxes are made from 85% FSC certified stock.Reducing bottled water waste by offering a convenient cleaning method for reusable drinking containers. Clean Ethics is making it even easier for people to choose to use a reusable bottle by offering a safe and easy way to keep their bottle fresh.Promoting domestic jobs and manufacturing by producing products that are made in the USA. They make our tablets, pouches and boxes and assemble all the parts here in the United States.Helping solve fundamental water sanitation issues in developing countries. There are a number of great organizations working to create new sources of clean water.  However, there remains a missing link to keeping that water clean; the dirty containers used to transport and store drinking water.  Many of these jerry cans, jugs, and bottles are unhygienic and there is no available method for cleaning them.  Building a new well or water purification system becomes less beneficial when people carry and store clean water in contaminated containers.

Clean Ethics aims to help fill this missing piece of the puzzle with hygiene education and the donation of Bottle Bright.  Their unique product is safe to handle, easily transported, and ecologically suitable for discharge on the ground.

Affect is part talks and part nonprofit group volunteering, featuring stories from activists, creators, and techies working in social impact. Attendees have traveled from Seattle, the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, D.C., and more cities to take part in the event and spent a half day helping out a nonprofit partner off-site.
 
 Past topics covered at Affect Conf include: designing in times of social conflict & transition, ethics of care in technologyNon-binary gender inclusivity and self-care while working in social good
 
 At its core, Affect is about valuing people from diverse backgrounds and trying to create the world that we want to live in. Being part of an established network that holds the same ideals allows us to partner with like-minded organizations and have an even bigger impact on our community.
 
 Affect's mission is to educate and inspire at the intersection of social change and systemic design, with an emphasis towards boosting the visibility of underrepresented groups and individuals working in the space.

Swift River Consulting uses the Salesforce platform to help organizations extendtheir reach, increase fundraising effectiveness, and better engage with constituents and communities.



Swift River Consulting prides itself on helping its clients save time and resources while simultaneously allowing nonprofits to more effectively reach their constituents. With an exclusive focus on small to medium-sized organizations, Swift River Consulting helps its clients apply industry-wide best practices using standard Salesforce technology. At the same time, Swift River Consulting is known as a partner for custom development to help leading-edge organizations use Salesforce and its related applications to empower their work.



We became a B Corp because we believe that our business can work hand in hand with the people we serve to create lasting impact. We believe in joining with other like-minded businesses to support each other in our efforts to translate ideas into results for our clients, our employees, and our communities.

The Change We Seek &reg:



Swift River Consulting seeks a world in which all nonprofits have access to the same powerful technology tools used for traditional business–including the Salesforce platform. Swift River Cosulting believes that technology can save hours of precious staff time for underesourced nonprofits. Swift River Consulting believes that with the Salesforce platform nonprofits can more easily track the impact of their programs, make adjustments, and communicate the needs and results to potential donors. Swift River Consulting seeks to empower clients to learn. grow, and use their own resources to advance their knowledge and use of technology.

Yummari is a family-owned, family-run company that specializes in creating healthy, minimally processed snacks and food products while putting a creative and nutritious spin on household staples such as energy bars and peanut butter. Husband-and-wife team Jason and Catherine Walsh started Yummari with the mission of making gluten-free, vegan, Non-GMO products with clean ingredient lists. Their first product lines focus on the Central American ancient food nutritional powerhouse: the chia seed.  Their vision was to create versatile and satisfying superfood products that people would incorporate into their daily eating habits when they were either training for a marathon or running errands on a busy afternoon.

We became a B Corp because, both as individuals and a company in the natural food space, we feel socially responsible and accountable for the products that we put in the marketplace and, as a natural extension of that, how we run our business. Becoming a B Corp fit perfectly with our desire to share that feeling and verify that philosophy with our customers, who make their own impact when they choose our Non-GMO Verified products made with Fair Trade ingredients. We are proud to be part of this global movement of entrepreneurs who conduct and grow their businesses differently.The Change We Seek	

Yummari's mission is to create products for people with driven lifestyles using the earth's natural superfoods. They strive to be a snack disruptor by creating healthy and deliciously satisfying products while staying committed to sourcing sustainable nutritious ingredients from responsible suppliers. In addition to providing healthy food products with clean ingredient lists, Yummari's partnership with 1% for the Planet provides the perfect opportunity to give back to the world we all share by donating a potion of annual revenue to social and humanitarian efforts.

Natural Beton and Biomattone based solutions are Leed certified and cover a wide range of applications for new buildings and refurbishments like high performance walling systems, roof and floor insulation, internal and external walls insulation, partitions and thermal plaster.
 
Equilibrium’s products and solutions maximise thermal and acoustic insulation and provide an excellent natural water vapour management resulting in healthy and comfortable buildings that save energy all year round. In addition, Natural Beton and Biomattone are able to overcompensate CO2 emissions thus making them a strong ally in the battle against climate change.

Inkkas is a team of dreamers. Their dream is to wander through the world finding the most beautiful local patterns and designs by working with local artists and artisans to make new clothing come true. Inkkas was born during a backpacking trip to South America in 2012. Danny Ben-Nun, a designer and an avid traveler, was wandering through the alleyways of Cusco, when he discovered a pair shoes made from authentic, local fabrics. The shoes were so beautiful that he knew from the moment he laid eyes on them, that he had to help bring the product to the global market. 

The Inkkas company was founded on the principles of fair trade, philanthropy and authenticity. In 2013, we launched the OneShoeOneTree™ project to help reforest the world and help local populations in developing countries at the same time.

The Change We Seek	

Inkkas seeks to help the world by producing its products in developing countries. They work with local artisans who use locally and authentically sourced materials. Additionally, Inkkas plants a tree in either Africa, Asia and South America for every pair of Inkkas purchased.

Bioplanet Corp manufactures and distributes environmentally-friendly disposable packaging and tableware to make this world a better place to live in. Bioplanet Corp. accepts that in our society the usage of disposable cups, plates, trays, bowls, take-out containers, trash bags and cutlery is part of everyday life and to try to stop it would be almost impossible, so they believe that for disposable items to 1) come from a sustainable renewable resource and 2) not harm the environment when discarded. RedShip.com offers college care package subscriptions that are tailored monthly to fit a student’s changing moods and activities at different times throughout the school year. RedShip allows parents to support their college student with what they need, when they need it, in a way that can’t be ignored. The subscriptions allow parents to order once and know that their student is taken care of year round. RedShip’s ongoing research, student engagement, and customer feedback ensure that each package is crafted to answer the needs of the student at the time of delivery. All packages ship in a giant red cylinder designed to create a meaningful experience from the moment the student sees it in the mailroom. 

We wanted to build a business that we could be proud of, with values that inspire others. The B Corp certification gave us a guide to accomplish this. The B Corp community has given us support and collaboration to help us positively impact the world around us. The Change We Seek	

RedShip strives to make a positive impact on the world with every care package sold. For each purchase, the company donates one meal to Feeding America, helping to reduce hunger nationwide. Nearly all products and materials are sourced locally to support local communities and decrease pollution caused by shipping. Packaging is made from recycled material and is designed to be recycled and/or upcycled (reused for another purpose). RedShip partners with and is endorsed by Terracycle, a company devoted to creating a cleaner, greener life. RedShip helps Terracycle spread their message on college campuses.

The founders of RedShip believe that environmentally and socially responsible business should be the norm. While the goal of a company is to be financially successful, the company should also strive to make a positive impact on the world around it.

In 2012, Mark Stempel awoke to the fact that the global economy was ravaging our planet and triggering a Critical Mass of complex, interrelated environmental, economic, social and political crises.  Up until that time he had been a successful wealth manager, managing client portfolios for competitive financial returns as well as helping clients to engage in strategic philanthropy.  He realized that this approach was insufficient to deal with the social and environmental challenges that we faced and sold his wealth management firm so that he could make himself available to address the social and environmental crises we faced.  

In 2013, Mark Stempel read a book entitled: ” Impact Investing” and realized that it was possible to serve clients with a blended approach to value, where value is a function of maximizing financial performance together with the pursuit of a defined measure of social impact and environmental promotion.  Mark was called to re-establish Encore Wealth Advisors with the mission of helping to address social and environmental challenges with for profit investment.

The Change We Seek

NEUW Ventures is an entrepreneurial environmental impact investing company. It creates and finances new businesses that reduce the human ecological footprint on our planet and accelerate the world’s transition to a sustainable economic system. It partners with early- and growth-stage companies with disruptive business models and where sustainability is a fundamental part of their business strategy. NEUW believes that sustainability is a core driver of long-term financial and operational performance.

NEUW's investments target key sectors of the economy that will drive this global shift to a sustainable system, including renewable energy, energy efficiency, waste and recycling, water technologies, land-use and food systems, mobility and lifestyle, and consulting & IT. In addition, the company invests in conservation and biodiversity finance opportunities with the aim of preserving the planet's valuable ecosystems, wilderness regions, and animal species.

As an impact investing company, NEUW Ventures aims to achieve both superior financial returns and measurable, positive environmental returns.

We are committed to a global transition to a sustainable economic system, and we believe that to achieve this the private sector must change its traditional model focusing primarily on profit. The B Corp model of inserting social and environmental purpose into the DNA of companies aligns with our values and objectives. 

We are delighted to be the 1st investment company in Switzerland to become a Certified B Corp. 

The Change We Seek	

NEUW Ventures deploys capital to private enterprises structured to effect positive environmental change. The themes & sectors targeted address specific ecological challenges, from climate change to water scarcity. NEUW focuses on opportunities delivering superior value creation in the long-term through resource efficiency, pollution prevention, waste management and renewable energy.

Across its investments, NEUW Ventures pursues a strategy designed to achieve deliberate and measurable positive ecological impacts. Its impact methodology seeks to assess, monitor and report impact over the life of the investment. Environmental metrics & indicators used relate to greenhouse gas, land-use, water use and waste.

Over time, NEUW aims to be able to assess environmental performance in the same way as financial performance.

Farm Brothers is an organic food company, started in 2013 by two best friends in the Netherlands. Since its founding, the mission has been to provide the world with wholesome, tasty, and affordable organic grain snacks that also increase awareness of the benefits of organic food for the planet and all beings living on it.
 
 So far, the company is on the right track with nationwide distribution in the Netherlands as well as expansion into several other European countries. Farm Brothers supplies its delicious cookies to mainstream and organic retailers, as well as supplying cookies to the best restaurants, hotels, catering companies, and health cautious companies as a mid-day snack.
 
 Farm Brothers was founded on believing the company’s primary attitude is to do good for people and the planet by producing products the right way. This means not only using organic ingredients but also paying a fair price to all involved in the complete supply chain. The company is convinced that the “Farm Brothers way” of doing business will eventually impact the food system as a whole. It seeks change by offering products that are delicious, have an appealing packaging design, and a decent price point in order for healthy organic snacks to be in arms reach of every household.

Green Alpha Advisors is an asset management firm founded in 2007.  They use science-driven, fundamentals-based research to invest in companies whose innovative products and services will transition us to the Next Economy.  Our world, encompassing both the economy and environment, faces three big systemic risks: an increasingly warmer climate, resource scarcity and booming population growth.  In order for human society to thrive, our economy and environment must transition to one in which they can co-exist indefinitely.  This is their vision of the Next Economy - what we must transition to.



Green Alpha uses their investment experience to harness the power of investment capital for good.  They seek to invest in companies that are creating products or services to help us mitigate and/or adapt to risks associated with climate change, resource scarcity and population growth.  Green Alpha portfolios have been fossil fuel free since inception.



We became a Certified B Corporation, because we fully believe in harnassing the power of capital and business to build a better society.  One in which we can all thrive.  Current business practices, incentive structures and the like are not helping business build the future that we all need - the Next Economy.  Green Alpha was founded with this ideal in mind, so it's no surprise that we would want to support the B Corp community and all that it's doing to help build a more sustainable future.

The Change We Seek	



Green Alpha Advisors is striving to help society transition to the Next Economy - one in which the economy and environment co-exist, so that human society can thrive indefinitely.  The three biggest systemic risks to both our economy and environment are: an increasingly warmer planet, scarce resources and booming population growth.  Green Alpha seeks to invest in companies that are creating products or services to help us mitigate or adapt to these risks.

All of Green Alpha's separate account and mutual fund investment strategies are built on this Next Economy investment philosophy.  They all follow the same rigorous investment process to create portfolios with different growth and income characteristics.

Manzimvula	 was founded in 1998 by Warren Te Brugge as a Management Consulting firm providing services to organizations in Canada and the United States with operations in foreign markets. Although the focus was initially in North America, the projects Manzimvula engaged in spanned the globe from North America to Europe, Asia and Oceania. Warren found his talent for helping others excel had significantly positive impacts on his clients’ growth.

The company places enormous value on their relationships with clients. Their client's trust is fundamental to developing their key strategies. At Manzimvula	 they collaborate with clients first as individuals then with the organization at large, enabling them to build strong and sustainable foundations. Their support helps them to capitalize on their uniqueness, strengths and unseen opportunities to create a culture of success.

While they now serve clients from multiple countries, their own expertise originates in South Africa where their understanding of human nature and drive was formatively shaped. Just as the Guiding Principles are the roots that ground the Manzimvula	 brand, the first letters of the six words representing the ACACIA tree (Acacia sieberiana) parallel those same rooted strengths, life-giving attributes and African heritage. Their guiding principles are: Altruistic - Connectedness - Aspiring - Caring - Innovative - Acceptance.

We believe that our words need to be matched by our actions. We want to support our clients and the people we collaborate with by taking actions that support what we do working with our clients and their organizational communities. We truly want to live our purpose and guiding principles. Being a B Corp is important to us as one of the steps we take in achieving that.

The Change We Seek	

Manzimvula	 Ventures, Inc., is a consulting practice whose purpose is to work alongside clients to address leadership, sustainability and corporate responsibility issues with a keen focus on establishing trust and enabling active and meaningful relationships across their broader stakeholder communities', to drive long-term growth and establish mutually beneficial relationships.

They guide clients through their Integrative Strategy Approach™, stimulating ingenuity and innovation, to embed sustainability into operations and support them in engaging their organizations and their communities at a deeper level, to understand mindset and create alignment with core values and principles.

The Manzimvula Team has focused significant energy to engage a broader community themselves, by taking on new opportunities to address and influence sustainability and leadership in the world around them by partnering with institutions like Arizona State University to develop postgraduate degree level programs. Manzimvula is also working with a number of additional institutions to develop similar programs as well.

As a team they take what they have learned in their consulting practice and apply it in Community Development projects through their Foundation, My Arms Wide Open	, to meet the needs of the communities they work within, while transferring skills, to drive change in the world around them.

The Big Blue Bike is an ethical and eco fashion brand that delivers style-focused and quality clothing produced with the goal of positively impacting on disadvantaged communities and the environment. A true social venture, the company's engagement with disadvantaged communities is at the very core of its operations. Every company decision is made in relation to the community it is impacting on.  

The Big Blue Bike was created to deliver positive social and environmental impact amongst its target communities. We believe that businesses can be a powerful tool for social and environmental change. Joining the B Corp community puts us in a position to set a precedent for the next generation of businesses.  The Change We Seek®  

The project is focused on empowering individuals amongst poor communities identified as belonging to the bottom 20% of income groups in Lima – a segment effectively excluded from the country’s growing economy and which is also prone to a range of social problems such as domestic violence. The material produced with is strategically sourced from rural herding communities, empowering them by increasing their participation in the supply chain while encouraging the rejuvenation of colored alpacas in Peru which are facing severe shortages. Market demand for only white alpaca fiber, due to easier application of chemical dyes on them, has led to a worrying decline in the colored alpaca population. The Big Blue Bike aims to replenish their numbers by creating market demand for colored alpaca fiber, subsequently encouraging herders to breed more of the colored animals.

With a holistic focus on practical solutions, SSC offers a variety of corporate sustainability services and training programs. What sets SSC apart is extensive experience in sustainability education and a thorough implementation process for:

  • Integrated Corporate-Wide Sustainability Programs and Training

  • Life Cycle Assessment, Environmental Product Declarations and Sustainable Product    Development

  • Sustainable Buildings Programs Incorporating ENERGY STAR and LEED    Certifications

The values and goals of B Corporations are aligned with SSC’s corporate vision and mission. For over a decade, SSC has served as a catalyst for environmental and social change. We welcomed the opportunity to unite with the like-minded organizations in the B Corp network to further this objective and realize the greatest benefit.The Change We Seek	

Often, there is reluctance to change a system that works; however, once a sustainable process is integrated - and demonstrates quantifiable benefits - attitudes shift. Through education and proven systems, Sustainable Solutions Corporation provides opportunities to reduce costs and improve environmental performance, proving that being a good steward of the environment is a sound business strategy. SSC’s goal is for manufacturers and organizations to recognize sustainability as a driver of innovation and improvement and an integral part of a profitable business plan.

YR&G provides technical and strategic sustainability consulting services to organizations, buildings, and communities across the U.S. and internationally. Through a combination of analysis, benchmarking, research, creative visioning, alignment, and education, we facilitate an integrated process and enable results through informed decisions. YR&G takes a multidisciplinary approach, linking the skills and knowledge of our core team of professionals - architects and engineers, teachers and business strategists, biologists and building scientists - to provide a broad and technically rigorous approach with a focused lens of sustainability. 

YR&G is organized into four key teams that work collaboratively to support a wide range of projects and client types. These teams are Building Design and Construction, supporting owners and project teams to optimize design and construction practices; Building Performance and Operations, working with facility managers, building engineers, property owners, and corporate real estate personnel to improve building performance and implement best practices across operations; Community and Neighborhood Development, supporting new and existing communities to become hubs of living and economic vitality; Corporate Sustainability, develop a comprehensive approach for managing sustainability initiatives and supporting implementation of those initiatives.

YR&G was founded in 2006 and has offices in New York City, Chicago, and Denver. We are a Certified Women's Business Enterprise and a Small Business Enterprise.

We believe that sustainability is rooted in socially and environmentally responsible business practices. Being part of the B Corp community allows us to shape the conversation about sustainability in business through collaboration with other like-minded companies.

The Change We Seek	

YR&G believes that the most sustainable outcomes occur at the intersection of people and technology, and we use this principle to guide our clients and projects to reach their highest potential. YR&G explores form and function in the built environment by looking at the definition of sustainability through a multi-disciplinary, inclusive lens. Sustainability consulting often rests on technical analysis, but YR&G maintains a people-centric focus throughout this process. By continually emphasizing how building design and construction impact end users, YR&G is able to help developers, architects, engineers and investors make informed choices that result in long-term, cost-effective sustainable outcomes. Through this combination of analysis, education, and outreach, YR&G is committed to working on sustainable, healthy buildings that improve quality of life and raise the industry bar for future efforts.

Canine herbalist and writer, Rita Hogan and dog nutrition specialist Lynn Higgins created their company, Farm Dog Naturals after they met and discovered their mutual interests: dogs and the environment. Founded in 2007, Farm Dog Naturals is a woman owned, sustainable company that handcrafts safe and effective herbal remedies for the all-natural dog. The ingredients are ethically sourced, organic when possible, non-gmo, vegan and cruelty free. Farm Dog works to support their community through a Sustain program where every three months a different animal rescue or environmental group receives a percentage of profits from wholesale and retail sales. The purpose of Farm Dog Naturals products is to make everyday life with your dog easier, safer and more environmentally sound.
 
 Most of our customers are trying to live an all-natural lifestyle for themselves. We work to encourage them to extend those same concerns for health and the environment into the products they choose to purchase for their dogs. Farm Dog Naturals strives everyday to educate our consumers, our retailers and our community about the all-natural dog, our products and the impact that pet ownership has on the environment.

Pozible is a crowd funding community and platform for project creators to present their ideas to a connected audience, worldwide. Pozible's community is made up of a supportive network of people who love getting behind innovative ideas, showing their support by pledging money and being involved in the creation process every step of the way.
 
Pozible all started a few years ago now, when Rick and Alan were working on a separate project and met an artist with amazing talent. Like many such artists, she was frustrated by having to keep her art 'on the side'. The story resonated. They'd heard it many times before from friends and colleagues.
 
They asked themselves: could crowdsourcing be used to make funds available in a way specifically suited to the needs of creative people?
 
Could they build a user-friendly tool allowing creators to secure pledges against offered rewards, thereby making resources available to creators during the critical production and development phases?
 
Driven by their own knowledge of start-ups and crowdsourcing for social enterprise and community development, they developed a model flexible enough for all kinds of endeavors, with few of the time and complexity issues of traditional funding models.

Merits è impegnata a creare innovazione sociale e sviluppo economico sostenibile e condiviso.
Si ispira alla cultura dell’Economia Civile, che pone al centro del modello economico la collaborazione e la reciprocità e si basa sulla valorizzazione di beni economici fondamentali come: beni comuni, beni relazionali, beni di gratuità.
Merits crea modelli di sviluppo socio-economico e tecnologia “centrata sulla persona” con l’obiettivo primario di arricchire il capitale sociale e relazionale delle comunità generando reti di scambio di valore in cui le transazioni tra gli attori coinvolti siano sempre correlate a principi etici e finalizzate alla creazione di un impatto sociale positivo.
La piattaforma digitale consente, in base a diversi modelli applicativi, di generare dei token definiti “merits”. I merits vengono attribuiti ai cittadini e alle organizzazioni che creano impatto sociale positivo e vengono utilizzati per fare acquisti nei negozi e servizi di prossimità o su piattaforme di e-commerce ESG.
I sistemi di pungoli (nudge) e di incentivi che Merits co-progetta con i propri partner ispira le persone ad agire per il benessere delle loro comunità, facendo sentire loro la riconoscenza per l’impegno profuso, innescando una spirale virtuosa che genera vantaggi per tutti

Cause4 champions disruptive philanthropy and new ways of scaling up charities and social enterprises supporting them to change and grow. A small team but with big ambition and a big heart, it’s not the size of project that matters to Cause4 but whether it can make an impact. Provoking change is at the heart of our mission. 
 
Cause4 works in partnership with corporations, charities and people to develop important charitable projects, create new business models, as well as to raise vital funds. Learning lessons from the private sector to benefit not-for-profit organisations, since set up in May 2009, Cause4 has raised over £46 million for clients, and is committed to helping attract the best graduate talent to work on some of the world’s most pressing issues.
 
Cause4 wants charities and social enterprises to become more business-minded; and businesses and corporate leaders to become more socially-minded. They believe that if these two sectors can meet in the middle, then everyone will see the greatest possible innovation in addressing issues of social need and challenge, allowing for huge impact in addressing some of the most intractable social problems in the world today, at a global and local level.

Established in 2012, Verdical Group is a leading green building consulting firm focused on decarbonizing the built environment and inspiring a net zero future. Verdical Group wrote the definition of "verdical" and defines it as, "an upward trend in positive environmental impact." They believe nature is the greatest teacher and work to make the built environment function more like the natural environment.

In 2012 Ethique started making unique formulas from their kitchen in Christchurch, New Zealand. With their knowledge of chemistry & biology Ethique wanted to create better cosmetics & they weren’t afraid to do things differently.
 
Ethique has now outgrown the kitchen and set up in their lab. But their core guiding principle remains the same: healthy products, made with sustainable, naturally derived ingredients. 
 
Ethique was started because hair & skin care needed a shake up: simple, concentrated & sustainable products that deliver on results, without the packaging.
 
Bars are the answer – no bottles, no harsh chemicals, just good things in high concentration. They're all about taking beauty products & making them super dense. Each bar is packed full of only good things that will work to bring out the best in your skin & hair.
 
Why bars?
Solid cosmetics have loads of benefits. They last for ages because they’re so concentrated – one bar of Ethique can last as long as five bottles of its liquid relative. And because there’s no water, Ethique doesn’t contain preservatives. ‘First do no harm’ is Ethique's priority, and they do that by making solid formulas.
 
For Ethique, sustainability runs deep. They started making beauty products because they know they can be made better.

Bicicleta Gestión de Desarrollo was born before the question about development, questioning the prevailing model that prefers economic success above social, cultural, individual and environmental success, which demands working for a fair and sustainable development.  That’s how La Bicicleta was legally constituted in April, 2012, seeking a new way to be an enterprise centered on people’s dignity.

We became a B Corp because we wish to be the best enterprise for the world instead of being the best of the world, by changing the way of doing business, to be more inclusive than just a business model, bringing business success to everyone. We do not conceive development if it doesn’t consider social and environmental variables.

We became a B Corp because an enterprise that generates a solution for a social and/or environmental problem creates value where it is lacking.

The bicycle is a metaphor for development. In a bicycle, through coordinated motion, in which every part plays a fundamental role, the moving forward capacity is multiplied without losing touch with the real world and what surrounds us; we are key players of our movement. We want to use the tools we are given from the world to serve its own development.

That’s why our projects begin within communities and organizations, helping to develop from within any changes necessary to sustainable development. Offering real value from people and for people.

With this scope, we manage and develop different projects in communities, as well as offering consultant services to enterprises or organizations, from whatever industry or economic sector, with a focus on improving internal practices and incorporating sustainable standards in their management and business models, internal valuation practices and improvement programs. We support the adoption of Enterprise Social Responsibility policies and practices, and B Corp certification.The Change We Seek	

 

 

We wish to encourage organizations and communities we are bound to in order to guide them toward a sustainable development in a human scale, placing people at its center. We wish to support a way of doing business that dialogues and listen to people, guarding human needs and future generations.

FlowOver brings Crowdfunding and Ecommerce together in a way so that everyone wins. FlowOver sites sell brand name products at the lowest prices online and also allow customers to donate 10% of their purchase price to the relief project of their choice. 

FlowOver relief grants don't just go to large non-profits. Rather, anyone with a qualifying project can submit their project to us directly. Early grant applications include a project to build a traditional Navajo hogan for a tribal elder, an effort to retrofit buses to create mobile showers for the homeless of San Francisco, and the rebuilding of a restaurant that served as a center for inspiration and employment for a small community decimated by Hurricane Sandy. 

FlowOver's pilot website is www.CabinetHardware.org. As Cabinet Hardware is a home improvement product, FlowOve is specifically funding grant proposals related to helping those who need assistance rebuilding a home or business. FlowOver is using the lessons learned from CabinetHardware.org to prepare their second site, www.LightFixtures.org (coming soon).

My background is in both the non-profit and for-profit worlds. I began my career as a litigator for the Natural Resources Defense Council and later founded Tail of the Lion, Inc., a network of ecommerce stores. These experiences led me to realize that both of these models were limited, and that our greatest chance for social progress is a hybrid model where doing good and making money are non-exclusive.

The Change We Seek	

FlowOver believes that every time you spend a dollar, you are casting a vote for the type of world you want to live in. For instance, the choice to buy organic carrots from a local farmer rather than saving by buying conventional, imported carrots helps to strengthen the local and organic food markets. Yet most purchasers give little thought to the impacts of their purchases because such impacts are often so far removed. FlowOver hopes to create a whole new awareness of the power inherent in our purchases by giving shoppers the ability to give to a specific beneficiary whose life can be improved through that transaction. Not only does FlowOver hope to help tens of thousands of deserving people through these grants, but they hope to revolutionize the way consumers think about their spending.

Paka is working to change the clothing industry.

Our clothing is woven from one of the softest and most functional natural fibers on planet Earth - the alpaca. All fiber is sourced from free-roaming alpacas in the Andes Mountains. We also employ naturally-gifted Quechua women, who handknit and sign each sweater they make. 

2/3 of all clothing is currently made of plastic, and we are just beginning to realize the consequences of this on the Earth. Not only is plastic made from petroleum (one of the most carbon-intensive processes), but the downstream route of microplastic pollution impacts every species on our planet; a study just revealed that Americans consume 5+ grams of plastic per week. Another study found 73% of fish caught at mid-ocean depths in the Northwest Atlantic have microplastic in their stomachs. To solve this, we've created a 100% earth-friendly fabric (Breathe By Paka™) - https://vimeo.com/473762838/c9f1733004. 

We’re working to build a new paradigm - one that is sustainable from the ground up. See everything that goes into our clothing, from the Andes Mountains —> your door (https://www.pakaapparel.com/pages/environment).

Savvy Rest is a Virginia-based natural mattress and organic bedding manufacturer. The company has ranked in the Inc. 500/5000 roster of AmericaÕs fastest-growing companies for three consecutive years. Savvy RestÕs founder, Michael Penny, took an unusual path to business. He lived for 20 years in a yoga ashram, consuming little and owning less. After leaving that community, Penny worked in a mattress store and was struck by two realizations: 1) most people shop for mattresses in a state of tension and mistrust because of traditional selling practices, and 2) most conventional or foam mattresses contain toxic chemicals, particularly flame retardants and pesticides, that threaten both human and environmental health. 
 
 Penny viewed the bedroom as a key retreat from pollutant exposure, and better sleep as essential to health. In 2003, he opened his own mattress store and in 2006, founded Savvy Rest. Penny made a connection with a natural latex supplier from India, who extended him credit on the strength of a handshake and their shared outlook. Penny chose natural latex, organic wool, and organic cotton as materials for Savvy RestÕs signature mattress because they do not expose sleepers to off-gassing chemicals or pesticide residues.

For 35 years, Hugh Lofting Timber Framing, Inc. has been crafting timber frame homes and structures. Incorporating advanced technology with old world craftsmanship, Hugh Lofting Timber Framing, Inc. is dedicated to hand-crafting energy-efficient homes and structures that are elegant and distinctive. Long interested in the construction and joinery of Chester and Lancaster County barns, Hugh was one of a handful of woodworkers responsible for the revival of the art of timber framing in the United States. Hugh has traveled extensively, domestically and abroad, studying timber framing methods across cultures. Their work is influenced by European, Asian and American techniques.
 
Since its infancy, Hugh Lofting Timber Framing has been dedicated to energy and design. Today the firm has embraced the use of FSC certified timbers and glued-laminated beams, reclaimed and salvaged woods, environmentally aware finishes, structural insulated panels and has a LEED-AP on staff. Their work includes architectural trusses, great room additions, whole home timber frames, commercial inns and office buildings, pavilions and barns.

A female-owned business founded in Bondi Beach Australia to address the problem of clothing textile waste. Bras are amongst the most toxic garments on the planet being almost all made from polyester, nylon and spandex. With the average woman owning 9 bras, and potentially 2m women on the planet wearing them, thats around 18m headed for landfill where they will give off methane gas over the 200 plus years it takes them to break down.
The Very Good Bra is the world’s first fully compostable, super-comfortable bra in 27 proper sizes, with everything including elastic, sewing thread and labelling being made from100% botanically circular materials meaning that at the end of life they can be disposed of in home compost or a worm farm.
To further minimise our impact we run pre-sales ensure we don't over produce, we offer replacement straps, and we have a facebook Buy Swap and Sell Group for bras needing new homes. We work with a social enterprise to warehouse and fulfil our orders, providing employment opportunities to people of all abilities who otherwise struggle to find meaningful work.
The Very Good Bra was awarded Best in Class  the 2020 Good Design Awards for Fashion Impact, and also won the 2021 Circle Award for Fashion in ANZ.

Launched in 2012, FIGS is revolutionizing the old and stodgy medical apparel industry.  FIGS has given the medical “uniform” a huge face lift by using 100% ridiculously soft, performance fabrics that are tailored to perfection.

Through their Threads for Threads initiative, for every set of scrubs sold, FIGS gives a set to a healthcare provider in need.  They work with International Medical Corps and other healthcare organizations to execute on their mission.

At FIGS, we believe in making a positive impact on the world.  Giving back is engrained into our culture and is the reason we wake up to do the work that we do.  Nurses, doctors, and healthcare students throughout the developing world do not have access to the proper sanitary uniforms to do their jobs safely. Being a B Corporation allows us to account for the promises we make to our customers, our employees, the environment, and the medical community around the world.

The Change We Seek	

Inspire Good Taste.

FIGS provides the highest quality medical apparel directly to their customers.  Medical professionals are their most cherished resource and they believe they deserve the best.  That is why they design and manufacture every piece with the medical professional in mind – laser focused on fit, comfort, functionality and performance.

Access to Sanitary Uniforms.

Many medical professionals in impoverished areas are poorly compensated for their hard work and dedication.  They simply do not have enough money for costly medical uniforms.  FIGS is here to help and provide them with the proper sanitary uniforms to do their jobs safely.

Reduce Hospital-Acquired Infections.

Without the proper medical attire, the spreading of disease and illness increases exponentially.  Clean scrubs reduce the hospital-acquired infection rate by 66% and result in millions of dollars saved from unnecessary treatments. 

Promote Professionalism, Identity, and Pride.

The medical uniform gives healthcare providers a recognizable symbol of caring and commitment, promoting a strong sense of pride, professional identity and teamwork.

C Level help companies calculate their carbon impact and balance it in nature-based solutions. For 20 years they have connected businesses with the best nature-based offset projects to 'bring carbon down to earth' (Carbon Balanced) and to explore radical ways to 'change culture not climate' (Wild Aligned).

C Level offer an easy-start, integrated solution to get you on the road to NetZero and balance your carbon in a simple first step - by calculating your basic carbon footprint and partnering you directly with award winning nature-based climate projects. They also offer a deeper dive into the carbon footprint of your value chain, more of your scope 3 emissions. All carbon balanced clients can go the extra mile, and deepen their engagement in rewilding, climate change and culture change, through membership of their Wild Aligned programme. C Level send regular updates from the field, Impact Communications that show the benefits of offsetting through them. They create films with partners and clients, and their C Tech enables automation of carbon calculations through their Balance Carbon API, as well as client branded action on carbon.  

C Level collaborate with several fellow B Corps on Carbon Balancing and Net Zero 2030 and would love to help further B Corps take that first step.

Csr eco solutions facilitates the redistribution of redundant assets on behalf of corporations, government institutions and healthcare facilities.  Their programs unlock the value trapped within no longer needed corporate and facilities assets and delivers the social and environmental value back to the community. Packaging focuses on two key ideas: (1) materials that break down naturally, and (2) the creation of circular systems of reuse that eliminate waste entirely. Meow Meow Tweet is also a certified Plastic Negative and Climate Neutral company.

Supplying wholesale to cafes and restaurants across Scotland and beyond, Glen Lyon also sell coffee online and through their roastery.
At the heart of their rural, highland community of Aberfeldy, Glen Lyon’s roastery is host to a monthly Repair Café as well as their Coffee Academy, which mentors young people into work with barista training, work placements and SCA qualifications. 
Glen Lyon’s commitment to zero waste and making their impact on the planet a positive one have seen the company pioneer the use of compostable coffee packaging in Scotland, install solar panels on their roastery roof and invest in an electric vehicle for local deliveries. Their ongoing partnership with the charity Trees for Life sees the Glen Lyon team head out annually to Glen Affric to plant trees while sales of their True North coffee go towards re-wilding projects in the Scottish Highlands.

After our experienced team of safety consultants recognised that many businesses were unsure how to implement their safety program, Safety Champion was born. We strive to make safety accessible and easier for all people, no matter their expertise. Relay Foods is the healthy online grocery store with a mission to make eating quality, healthy, sustainable food simple. Offering easy online ordering for local, organic, and everyday groceries, an integrated meal planning service, and convenient home delivery or free pick up, Relay Foods is changing the way people get their groceries and raising the standards for local quality.

Relay Foods’ mission extends far beyond a single financial bottom line – we seek to offer a service that will strengthen local food economies and improve the quality of life of each family and individual we serve. Becoming a B Corp has been a critical goal since our company’s founding, as it provides us with an unique opportunity to examine the strengths we have already developed and to identify social, environmental, and economic goals we can work toward as a value-based company.

We also sought certification as a means of interacting with like-minded entrepreneurs and corporations to develop triple bottom line solutions together in a dynamic and ever-changing food economy.

The Change We Seek	

Relay Foods seeks to create and support a robust, thriving local food economy in each market it serves by creating simple access to fresh foods grown and produced by local farmers and artisans. By providing a broad, efficient market for local producers, it will make high-quality, fresh ingredients just as accessible and affordable as the processed factory foods that Americans eat today. By changing the overall dynamics of how people access food, Relay also hopes to significantly reduce the overall carbon footprint of the industry by removing unnecessary food miles that separate consumers from fresh foods.

Additionally, Relay Foods works to promote healthier communities by selectively promoting healthier grocery offerings and providing resources on nutrition and diet through the website and blog and by working with local schools, businesses, and organizations to promote healthier lifestyles through food choices.

 The solution to this broken and underserved market is Unforgettable. The mountain towns around Lake Tahoe are home to an outdoor counterculture that could only exist in California.
Born of the region’s contrasts of peaks and lakes, snow and beach, it’s a place full of rebellious, youthful energy a place where the only thing taken as seriously as outdoor performance is having a good time.

We got our start making a simple yet symbolic beacon of the California Mountain Life: the trucker hat.

But we're far more than just a hat. California has always been home to a unique brand of energetic counterculture. A place that still believes that the best athlete on the mountain is the one having the most fun. A place that created its own numerical assessment of radness where international icons drop cliffs naked and where 12-year-old groms call out pros in the lift line. A place where you can climb tall Sierra granite in the morning and crack a beer from the comfort of an inner tube on the Truckee River that afternoon.

We hatched bigtruck® to celebrate this place and the people who give it it’s irreverently adventurous spirit but if we’re honest, this is all so much bigger than the hat, it just has to be... We are bigtruck®.

Juhudi Kilimo provides rural smallholder farmers with a unique type of micro-asset financing to purchase agriculture assets such as dairy cows, poultry, greenhouses and biogas digesters.  These assets generate income for the farmers and also act as collateral for the loans. The asset financing allows Juhudi Kilimo to work in the poorest rural communities in Kenya where little business activity or collateral exists. The micro-asset loans dramatically improve both income and food security for the farmers. For example, a farmer can take a loan for a high-yield dairy cow which will generate enough milk in 12 months to pay for the cow, the interest on the loan, the training, and still leave the farmer with extra income and milk to benefit a family. Once the loan has been repaid the farmer will own the asset and after several loans they can build an entire asset base which can double and triple the farmer’s income.

As Juhudi Kilimo we have a common goal with B Corp. We want to share how social businesses are addressing major challenges and serving clients. The B Corp certification lets us tell a little of our story, be compared to other social businesses, and benefit from access to services that are normally only available to non-profits.

Juhudi maximizes the benefit of asset financing by providing both technical assistance and business training. Prior to each loan, officers visit the client's farm to perform a business assessment and advise on improvements. The first four meetings of a new group are then devoted to training clients on basic finance and business. After a loan is approved officers give continued support, working with partners and local government ministries to offer targeted technical assistance on assets. To best serve rural clients, Juhudi also uses mobile technology to collect payments and feedback and reduce the burden on clients and loan officers in these remote areas.

Since inception in 2009, Juhudi Kilimo has provided a total of 20,120 farmers with loans worth $11.7 million. The average on-time repayment rate over the last four years has stayed at 95%.  Juhudi Kilimo was recognized in 2011 at the World Economic Forum with the Social Entrepreneur of the Year Award and then in 2012 by the Citi Foundation’s Microfinance Awards in Kenya.  In 2012 Juhudi Kilimo reached profitability with the support of its current investors and lenders such as the Acumen Fund, Grameen Foundation, Soros Economic Development Fund, Ford Foundation, Rockefeller Foundation and Kiva.

 

The Change We Seek	

Rural asset financing is an innovative approach to both poverty alleviation and food security in Kenya. It provides smallholder farmers with access to wealth-creating assets (such as cows or irrigation systems) that generate the income required to repay small loans and improve food yields on the farms. Asset financing differs from micro credit in that the loan is linked to a specific incoming-generating asset, as opposed to a general loan that could be used for consumption or emergency funding. Asset financing's cost-effective advantage over conventional loans enables Juhudi to offer its clients lower interest rates, staggered payments, and longer repayment periods that align with the client's sales performance.

Living Forest Communities (LFC) is a social enterprise between the for-profit Living Forest Limited Partnership and the registered charity, the Trust for Sustainable Forestry (the Trust). LFC has created a unique community development model that accomplishes two goals: providing a new finance mechanism for large scale forest conservation, and creating a new and sustainable development pattern for residential hamlets built within the forest.

This new development model requires that 85% of forested land be conserved as Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certified eco-forestry or in outright conservation covenants with limited or restricted access. To ensure that LFC remains true to FSC standards, a yearly audit is performed by a third party (Ecotrust Canada) prior to the annual renewal of the FSC certification. The actual timber rights are donated to the Trust, and the Trust receives stumpage fees for the timber that is felled. This means that no strata corporation or private entity in future can decide that they either want to expand the amount of forestry or eliminate eco-forestry altogether.

On the remaining 15% of the land, conservation communities are built. These communities feature clustered "light-on-the-land" home sites modeled after traditional European hilltop hamlets, and focus on the use of green building technologies. Within the communities, space is allotted for sustainable activities such as organic gardening, eco-tourism, environmental education, eco- and agroforestry and related value-added manufacturing activities on those areas that are developed.

LFC’s current project, Elkington Forest, is located on Vancouver Island, only 35 minutes north of Victoria, BC. Elkington Forest is a 1000 acre forest, with 850 acres of conserved forest land. On the other 150 acres, half of the land is reserved for food production, and half is developed into three residential Hamlets with a total of 77 homes and 15 eco-businesses.

We became a B Corporation because our goals are closely linked with that of the B Corp community: to use business as a tool to make positive impacts on the environment and society, and to build stronger communities. The comprehensive and independent assessment system for B Corps provides a reliable classification for potential investors, home buyers, and the public to reference LFC against, and assists us with increasing the transparency of our operations.

The Change We Seek	

LFC seeks to establish and maintain sustainable natural forest ecosystems in perpetuity through land conservation, ecosystem-based forestry, and the development of mixed-use conservation communities. The LFC forest stewardship model provides a new and unique way of saving forest ecosystems because the community committed to its conservation lives embedded within it.

In Ticketing is a premiere technology company providing ticketing and e-commerce solutions for bands, venues and festivals. Since 1999, In Ticketing has given clients the ease of using online ticketing, box office software, on-demand ticket printing, access control, and e-commerce solutions to grow their businesses. In Ticketing has a reputation of revolution, having developed such innovations as paperless will-call, wireless handheld scanning for tickets at events, and an access control system that allows event organizers to manage their on-site resources.  

The values advanced by B Lab and B Corporations are ones that are important to us and also to our stakeholders. By becoming a B Corporation, we are better able to broadcast our commitment to those values and hopefully set an example of social and environmental responsibility in our community.  

Committed to enhancing the experience for clients by creating services that make event management easy and fun, In Ticketing services are simple to use and reliable, saving time and worry so clients can concentrate on the event. In Ticketing services make it easier, quicker and cheaper to buy  tickets and get into events, enhancing both the client and consumer  experience, and all this in a way that is good for the planet. The company’s reputation for excellent service, knowledge, community involvement, and environmental values has made In Ticketing a respected leader among concert fans and the industry.  

  The Change We Seek™  

In Ticketing is committed to preserving and rejuvenating the environment. We connect with green festivals, events, bands and initiatives from all over the world to diminish our collective carbon footprint and raise awareness of how all of us can help out as we go out to shows and events.  

• In Ticketing is an official green business, adopting such sustainable practices as using soy ink with hemp/flax ticket stock, tree-free envelopes, bio-diesel and hybrid event vehicles.  

• In Ticketing created the Global Cooling Collective in 2003. GCC is dedicated to balancing environmental impact through a pledge to reduce the effects of global warming by planting trees. We combine our strengths with communities of concert goers around the world to create a healthier, more beautiful planet full of life and fresh air. We are the first ticketing agency to develop tree planting initiatives - resulting in the planting of hundreds of thousands of trees since its inception.  

• When you buy tickets from In Ticketing, you have the option to help offset your environmental impact of attending the event by purchasing Green-e certified Renewable Energy Credits. Since July of 2007, In Ticketing has offset approximately 6,525,367 pounds of carbon dioxide (CO2) through the Green Ticket Program from Green Mountain Energy Company.

Sustainable Earth Solutions seeks to empower its clients to discover novel and useful ways to save money and gain competitive advantages through sound sustainable practices. The need and value for social responsibility is part of the SES mission.

The members of the SES team serve as an “uplifting agent” for businesses and organizations in our community through sustainability consulting. The SES team acts as change agents for the businesses in WNY to create a climate of creative enterprises fostering genuine sustainable and social justice.

The Core Values:

Wisdom - Services are supported by a team of qualified professionals with diverse experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

Integrity – The team values being honest and having strong moral principles in all relationships with its clients, community members and society.

Trust – Team member actions foster a sense of shared reliance. Trust is a precursor to healthy relationship building.

Innovation – Through the creation of useful ideas and new actions, a sustainable model emerges.

Synergy - The result of the interaction of two or more persons or organizations creates a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects.

The SES team commits time, resources and staff throughout the year with its non-profit partners.  Each year in March, SES runs its Young Adults Environmental Leadership Program - YAELP.  Over the last 6 years, 50 teachers and 350 students have benefited from the skills acquired through their environmental projects made possible through YAELP.

B Corps represent a visionary community of how best to design and manage a business. We feel being a member of this community will synergize us in achieving our core values. We are proud of the efforts we make to be authentically green and B Corp is a brand that establishes that.

The Change We Seek	 

Sustainable Earth Solutions educates its clients in the power of creative thinking as applied to the use of proven sustainability models. Businesses that operate on the principles of environmental sustainability are the catalysts in modeling social and environmental justice. Through a collaborative network of communication and support, SES’s clients synergize business practices that sustain our Earth.

A primary piece of the infrastructure addressed in SES training is Change Leadership. Five leadership domains including Creativity, Intellect, Psychological Insight, Heart Centeredness and Perseverance guide the sustainability process through phases of implementation.

Sustainable Earth Solutions helps to uplift the communities in which it operates. This is achieved by training young adults in those communities in the applied use of creativity, project design and management, change leadership and environmental and social justice. Teams of teachers and students from local schools design environmental projects which are implemented as a means of gaining the skill sets necessary for our future leaders. Since 2007, the Young Adults Environmental Leadership Program – YAELP has trained over fifty teachers and four hundred students.

Little Pickle Press ("LPP") is an award-winning creator of high quality, high impact media and products for children and teens. Founded in 2009, LPP is dedicated to fostering kindness in young people—and doing so in a manner congruent with that mission. The Company defines "kindness" as treating others as one would wish to be treated in similar circumstance and considers it the foundational concept upon which civilization was built and the key to society's future.

From publishing picture books on recycled paper, with soy inks, in the Americas, and without a dust jacket that isn't kid-friendly or necessary, to sharing more control, rights, limelight and royalties with their artists, LPP aims to lead the change in children's content, product creation and beyond. Apps, songs, video/film, teacher guides, and more expand the universe and themes of each story, enabling LPP to leverage its unique and compelling intellectual property to entertain . . . and change the world for the better.

Our meaningful stories talk the talk, and being a B Corp shows we walk the walk! The values embraced by B Lab and B Corporations are our values, and we, our stakeholders, and our audience of caring adults, want the young people in our lives to own these values as well: Be kind to yourself, Be kind to others, Be kind to the Earth. By becoming a B Corporation, we are better able to demonstrate our commitment to these values and lead by example.

The Change We Seek	

At LPP, production and distribution are handled differently than at other media companies. From the much greener way it produces and distributes print books, to supporting small businesses, to forging partnerships with—and making donations to—organizations that help children and youth in meaningful ways, the WAY things are done is just as important as the WHAT is being done. In every decision, judging how it will serve LPP’s mission of kindness is always the determining factor.

And LPP's support of young people is visionary as well. By forging strategic partnerships that align with the values of a specific title with both a corporate partner and a non-profit beneficiary, LPP expands the message of each story, delivers content value to all partners and consumers, and donates 15% of net sales of that product to the non-profit partner. For its picture book,The Cow In Patrick O'Shanahan's Kitchen, LPP teamed up with fellow B Corp Cabot Creamery Cooperative and the non-profit ONE Campaign to expand the reach of the story about where the food on young people's plates comes from. 15% of net sales over a ten-month period were donated to the ONE Campaign's fight to end hunger in our world. And 15% of sales of the Farm2Table app, part of the same story universe, is going to the non-profit KaBOOM!, to help bring active play into the lives of children growing up in poverty in America.
